sentences.en: This necklace of Jane's is a gift from her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 简的这条项链是她祖母送给她的。

sentences.en: Grandmother looks very comfortable in that chair beside the fire.
sentences.zh: 祖母坐在壁炉旁的椅子上看起来很舒服。

sentences.en: The family was shook up when the grandmother died unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 当祖母意外去世时，全家人都感到震惊。
